metadata.selection: Per dataset, pretrained DUSt3R (224) was run on up to 20,000 candidate pairs (seed 42) with at least 5% co-visibility; the 1,000 pairs with the highest relative rotation error form the dataset's pool. No pair shares a sequence, scene, image, room or building with the Click3R training data. CO3D (109 pairs): the candidates come from the 499 held-out CO3D v2 test sequences of Table 1; pairs of a frame with itself and repeats of the same two frames (the lowest pair_idx kept) were removed before the pool was cut, and 109 pairs were sampled from the pool with random.Random(42). Habitat (100): 46 pairs of an earlier list whose scene shares no room or building with the training scenes, and 54 sampled with random.Random(42) from the other such pairs of the pool. BlendedMVS (97) and WildRGB-D (98): part of an earlier list of 500 pairs sampled with random.Random(42) from the merged pools of five datasets, including CO3D, Habitat and MegaDepth.

fields.pair_idx: index of the pair in the DUSt3R loader of `dataset`; for CO3D, Co3d(split='test') on the held-out test sequences
fields.image1_path: RGB path relative to the dataset's <name>_processed_for_dust3r folder
fields.dust3r_rre: pretrained DUSt3R relative rotation error (degrees), the selection statistic
